items.name: Purpose, availability and obligation controls
items.summary: Illustrates the constraints on use and recording of federal appropriations. No specific account, program, Treasury Account Symbol, apportionment, obligating official, or enacted fiscal-year appropriation is verified.

items.name: Civilian direction of Defense and conditional command chain
items.summary: Title 10 role-specific civilian direction and conditional combatant command chain; not an individual signed delegation, deployment order, UCP, or authorization for a particular use of force.

items.name: Federal question civil case jurisdiction
items.summary: Class-level 28 U.S.C. § 1331 jurisdictional grant; case-specific subject matter, standing, sovereign immunity, remedy, and claim viability remain separate questions.

items.name: Supreme Court discretionary appellate review context
items.summary: Section 1254 review routes for courts of appeals; never infers a guaranteed appeal, automatic Supreme Court jurisdiction, or relief in any case.
